<div class="card-body">
'''Gaderffii Stick''' is a [[Dark]] [[Weapon]] ([[Character Weapon]]) from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ガダフィの杖</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">２フォース消費して、タスケン・レイダーに配備する。起動にフォースを必要としない。その場で戦闘が始まった場合、即座に運命数を２枚引く。２枚の運命数の合計＞５ならば、敵は武器を“はじき飛ばされて”、この戦闘では使えなくなる。</span><ref name="jp1-face">Japanese text as on the [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-PSA-14-Face.jpg|Japanese Premiere printed face]] of [[Gaderffii Stick (Japanese)]]; checked line by line against this Two-Player face, which prints the same text.</ref>
<ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Two-Player-Gaderffii-Stick-SWCCGcards.jpg|This Two-Player printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">“ガッフィ”とも呼ばれる、タスケン・レイダーの好む武器。廃棄された金属などで作られる。相手を脅し、恐怖させるに十分な武器である。</span>''
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Gaderffii staff.

'''Card text:''' Spend 2 Force to deploy on a Tusken Raider. No Force is required to activate it. If a battle begins there, immediately draw two destiny. If their total is greater than 5, the enemy's weapons are ‘knocked away’ and cannot be used in this battle.

'''Lore:''' A weapon favored by Tusken Raiders, also called a ‘gaffi.’ Made from discarded metal and similar materials, it is sufficient to threaten and frighten an opponent.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese says activating it requires no Force; the English says it may target for free. The Japanese describes a battle beginning there, while the English says a battle has just been initiated where the weapon is present.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Gaderffii Stick]] in [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 44, 105. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
